newsitem.title: LATVIA: POWER OUTAGE SHUTS TALLINN BOURSE FOR 30 MINUTES.
newsitem.headline: POWER OUTAGE SHUTS TALLINN BOURSE FOR 30 MINUTES.

text.p: Trade on the Tallinn bourse was temporarily suspended for 30 minutes on Thursday due to a power black-out, a bourse official said.
"Trade was stopped from about 12:15 to 12:45 (0915-0945 GMT) because of techincal difficulties stemming from a power outage which affected parts of the city," the official told Reuters.
"Everything is up and running again and we do not anticipate any further problems," the official added.
